name: Starter: Slovak
about: Slovak word order and cases in real, everyday sentences.

words.mať sa: to be doing, to fare (ako sa máš: how are you)
words.po: in (with a language, as in po slovensky: in Slovak)
words.volať sa: to be called (ako sa voláš: what's your name)
words.páčiť sa: to please (páči sa mi: I like it)
words.rád: glad; likes to, gladly (masculine; feminine rada)
words.kino: movie theater (do kina: to the movies)
words.dať: to give (daj mi vedieť: let me know)

dal-by-som-si.about: A polite way to order or ask for something; a woman says Dala by som si.

prepáčte.about: To get someone's attention or say sorry: polite to one person, or to more than one; one friend gets Prepáč.

items.means: When I get home, I'll cook dinner.

I hope it's nice out tomorrow.

concept.line: The verb's ending marks person and number: (ja) bývam, (ty) bývaš, (on, ona) býva, (my) bývame, (vy) bývate, (oni, ony) bývajú.

words.means: mám = I am doing; sa = myself

concept.line: A Slovak verb often makes its subject clear, so ja, ty, my and the like are usually left out unless they're needed for contrast or emphasis: Bývam v malom byte; Neviem, kde býva.

words.means: som = I am; si = you are

concept.line: The present of byť (to be) is som, si, je, sme, ste, sú, and subject pronouns are usually left out when the form or context makes them clear: Som učiteľ (I'm a teacher); Kde sú moje kľúče?

words.means: mám = I have; máš = you have; nemám = I don't have

concept.line: Slovak nouns are masculine, feminine or neuter.

words.means: hovoríš = you speak; hovorím = I speak
nerozumiem = I don't understand; rozumieš = you understand
in (with a language, as in po slovensky: in Slovak)

concept.line: The accusative marks many direct objects: káva becomes Pijem kávu, and masculine nouns for people and animals change too (dvoch bratov).

words.means: bývam = I live; bývaš = you live; býva = lives
idem = I go; ideš = you go; ide = goes

concept.line: A yes/no question often keeps the order of a statement and is signaled by question intonation; a question word like kde, čo or ako usually comes first, and Slovak adds no do.

words.means: pracujem = I work; pracovať = to work
